turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Good morning, private banking, Rachel Tan speaking. Hello, Mr Lim. Are you somewhere comfortable to speak privately? We can keep the call brief if you have another appointment coming up.

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Hi Rachel, Adrian here. Yes, I'm in my office with the door closed. I've set aside a little time before my next meeting, so now is a good time.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Thank you. Before we get into the main part of the call, may I take your identification details for verification? I'll wait while you get settled.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Thank you for that. I'll keep the conversation direct. [[EV_001]]

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: I've prepared my notes, so let me give you the details together. [[EV_013]] [[EV_017]] [[EV_014]] [[EV_015]] [[EV_016]] [[EV_018]]

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: I'll cover the required points now. [[EV_002]] [[EV_003]]

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: [[EV_010]] Before the final readback, is telephone still your preferred way for us to contact you about account administration?

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Yes, please call me directly. During consultancy meetings I usually leave my phone on silent. If I miss you, leave a brief message with your name and I'll return the call when I'm free.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Noted. There's no need to discuss private account information in a voicemail. Will you be travelling soon, or should we continue using your usual contact arrangements?

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: I'll be away next week for work, mostly meeting clients. My mobile will still be with me. Afternoons are generally easier, but please message first so I can find a quiet place to talk.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: That's helpful, thank you. We can arrange future conversations around your availability. Let me return to the readback now. [[EV_008]]

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Thank you, Mr Lim. We'll use the usual secure channel for the account paperwork. If you're travelling when it arrives, you can access it whenever you're somewhere private.

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Okay, that suits me. I prefer keeping the paperwork separate from my work email. If there's an administrative question, a quick phone call is easier than a long email exchange.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: I've noted your contact preference. Thank you for making time this morning, and have a good trip. I'll let you get back to your meeting.

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Thanks, Rachel. Appreciate you keeping the call focused. Speak another time. Bye.
